profile.title: Independent BHPH dealer
profile.detail: Two lots in the Dallas–Fort Worth metro, selling and financing ~70 vehicles a month.

profile.title: In-house note portfolio
profile.detail: Roughly $4.2M in face value across ~610 active accounts, serviced by your own team.

profile.title: Growing Texas market
profile.detail: DFW subprime auto demand keeps growing — inventory, not demand, is your constraint.

profile.title: Rising cost of funds
profile.detail: Floorplan and credit-line rates remain elevated, squeezing margin on every financed unit.

challenges.title: Cash is locked in slow-paying notes
challenges.detail: Capital sits in 30–42 month notes while inventory opportunities pass by every week.

challenges.title: Delinquency is creeping up
challenges.detail: Industry data shows subprime auto 60+ day delinquency near record highs — every month of holding adds charge-off risk.

challenges.title: Collections overhead keeps growing
challenges.detail: Skip tracing, repossessions and compliance eat into servicing margin on the tail of the portfolio.

challenges.title: Single-buyer offers feel like lowballs
challenges.detail: Direct offers from one local buyer give you no way to know the real market price of your paper.

industryInsights.fact: Subprime auto 60+ day delinquencies hovered near record levels through 2025–2026.
BHPH dealers' average cost of funds rose ~250 bps since 2022.

solutions.title: Turn notes into cash in ~14 days
solutions.detail: The average Debexpert auction closes and funds in about two weeks — capital goes back into cars on your lot.

solutions.title: Transfer the risk while prices are strong
solutions.detail: Selling performing paper today locks in value before delinquency erodes it. Recourse and non-recourse structures available.

solutions.title: Sell the tail, keep the core
solutions.detail: Auction skips, deficiencies and charge-offs so your team services only accounts that pay.

solutions.title: Let 500+ buyers set the price
solutions.detail: A competitive auction replaces guesswork: verified buyers bid against each other, and you see every bid.

byType.note: Fintech lenders and investors active in consumer and specialty receivables.
Certified and associate debt buyers purchasing performing and charged-off portfolios.
Agencies buying paper they will work themselves — strong bidders on skips and deficiencies.
Originating lenders acquiring portfolios adjacent to their core business.
Legal-network buyers focused on judgments and legal-stage accounts.
Registered buyers pending classification, brokers, affiliates and partners.
